provisional_note: Provisional deltas for audit adjudication. No canon is minted here. Existing catalog.*/UCC IDs are cited as evidence (reuse_existing), never modified. Candidate IDs flagged new_candidate require catalog adjudication before wiring gates trust them.
census_method: grep -rhoE of catalog\.[a-z_]+ and UCC-[0-9]+ and cmd\.[a-z_.]+ across Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md and Plans/Wiring_Matrix.production.json; then family-specific greeps for theme/notifications/sound/spell/provider/tray/teacher.

disposition_legend.reuse_existing: An existing canonical command already owns this action; wire to it unchanged.
disposition_legend.alias: An existing command is the real owner; the candidate is a compatibility alias only.
disposition_legend.supersede: An existing command describes retired behavior; preserve deep-link semantics, replace the surface.
disposition_legend.conflict: Candidate collides with an existing command's ownership; requires adjudication.
disposition_legend.new_candidate: No existing canon; provisional ID for audit adjudication.

conflict_register.note: cmd.alert.acknowledge/snooze/dismiss/open_source/mute_rule (UCC-108) own the ATTENTION ALERTS/CONCERNS system. cmd.notifications.* own DELIVERY ROUTING (8 destinations). Atlas treats them as fully independent event families and aliases neither to the other.

cmd.orchestrator.pause/resume are RUN-scoped (goal/scheduler). App tray Pause/Resume/Quit are app-lifecycle (cmd.app.*). Atlas candidate cmd.app.tray.minimize/quit and window.state.restore are deliberately distinct namespaces.
Bloom modal superseded by atlas region/minimap nav; deep-link + focus-highlight semantics preserved. Compatibility alias only if external callers depend on it.
